responsibility: Implements compilation of trait-associated items in the Rust backend. It lowers trait constants through the shared constexpr/constant-item path and trait methods through the shared function builder after monomorphization and duplicate-compilation checks, producing references suitable for both direct compilation and on-demand trait-item resolution.
same_name_distinction: Implements compilation of associated items, especially trait item constants and methods, including monomorphization checks, duplicate-compilation reuse, and conversion to callable/addressable references. Unlike the header, it contains the actual trait-item visitor logic instead of just declaring the inherent-impl proxy and trait-item compiler interfaces.
